grid.order: row-major; row 0 = north edge, col 0 = west edge

thermal_inertia.label: Thermal inertia (THEMIS)
thermal_inertia.interpretation_note: Rough classes after Putzig & Mellon (2007) and Fergason et al. (2006); guidance only.

source.title: THEMIS-derived Thermal Inertia of Jezero Crater, Mars

minerals.label: Minerals (CRISM)
minerals.note: Mineral names are the closest match of each spectral prototype (dataset README). Medium-confidence pixels are kept and flagged.

source.title: Map of the dominant mineralogy over and around the Mars2020 landing ellipse
source.creators: Parente, M., Saranathan, A. M., Itoh, Y., Tarnas, J. D., Seelos, F. P., Mustard, J. F.

rock_relief.label: Rock relief (HiRISE 1 m DTM)
rock_relief.method: max−min of the 1 m DTM after removing each 4 m cell's best-fit plane
rock_relief.note: Proxy for boulders and rock outcrops. A 1 m DTM resolves features of a few metres; smaller rocks are not seen.

source.title: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation HiRISE DTM Mosaic (1 m)
